developer_path.title: Developer Path Exposure Analysis
developer_path.description: developer-session assumed AWSAdminRole to access bucket S3-Customer-PII-DB.
developer_path.analysis: A local developer session lacks Multi-Factor Authentication conditions, allowing sts:AssumeRole bypass and inheritance of administrative policies.
developer_path.remediation: Update the trust policy document of AWSAdminRole to validate MFA presence and source IP ranges.
